svg.text: Critical percolation: no infinite cluster at pc
Bond percolation on the square grid, the oldest case (Harris 1960, Kesten 1980), where pc = 1/2.
One seeded sample per panel (34 x 34 box, seed 213). Samples illustrate the three regimes; they are not evidence for the theorem.
Pn(p), n = 1..7; steeper as n grows
Rectangle: (n+1) x n sites, left-right crossing.
Its dual is the same rectangle turned 90 degrees, so
exactly one of crossing / dual crossing occurs:
P(p) + P(1-p) = 1 holds as a polynomial identity.
over all configurations agrees for n = 1..4.
The collection claims no infinite cluster at pc on every quasi-transitive graph with pc < 1; nothing on this card checks that proof.
